newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Thank you Rio, Chirac tells Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Thank you Rio, Chirac tells Argentina.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac got his geography wrong at the end of a hectic tour of five South American nations, thanking the Rio de Janeiro mayor for his hospitality in Buenos Aires.
"I was very touched by the welcome I received here from the president, the government, the city hall of Rio," he told a news conference in the Argentine capital.
Chirac stumbled at the last hurdle, the closing news conference of his week-long trip that took him to eight cities in Brazil, Uruguay, Bolivia, Paraguay and Argentina.
